name: Skills and contexts from files
objective: Brings skills (how to do one kind of thing) or contexts (knowledge for one purpose) into the library from Markdown files - written by hand, or exported from another AI system with the porting guide. Each file is one object: a header between --- lines (name, about, tags, optional id), then its text. An object the library already holds the same is left; a different one under the same name is kept beside it as name-2 unless Replace is ticked (and a replaced one stays as an earlier version).

picked.label: Files and folders
picked.hint: A folder stands for every .md and .txt file in it.

replace.label: Replace one of the same name
replace.hint: Off: a different object under a name already used is saved as name-2.

plan.name: Read one file as a library object

config.expr: (lambda parts: (lambda meta, body: dict(name=meta.get('name') or path.rsplit('/', 1)[-1].rsplit('.', 1)[0], about=meta.get('about', ''), tags=[x.strip() for x in meta.get('tags', '').split(',') if x.strip()], text=body.strip(), source=meta.get('source', ''), **({'id': meta['id']} if meta.get('id') else dict())))(dict((l.split(':', 1)[0].strip().lower(), l.split(':', 1)[1].strip()) for l in parts[1].splitlines() if ':' in l), parts[2]) if len(parts) == 3 and not parts[0].strip() else dict(name=path.rsplit('/', 1)[-1].rsplit('.', 1)[0], about='', tags=[], text=text.strip()))(text.split('---', 2))
